items.name: EMetric.continuousAt_iff
items.type: {β : Type v} {α : Type u_2} [PseudoEMetricSpace α] [PseudoEMetricSpace β] {f : α → β} {a : α} : ContinuousAt f a ↔ ∀ ε > 0, ∃ δ > 0, ∀ ⦃x : α⦄, edist x a < δ → edist (f x) (f a) < ε

items.name: Metric.continuousAt_iff
items.type: {α : Type u} {β : Type v} [PseudoMetricSpace α] [PseudoMetricSpace β] {f : α → β} {a : α} : ContinuousAt f a ↔ ∀ ε > 0, ∃ δ > 0, ∀ ⦃x : α⦄, dist x a < δ → dist (f x) (f a) < ε
